### The Ultimate Response to God
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/the-ultimate-response-to-god
Passage: Deuteronomy 6:4-5
Points:
- Knowing God is an essential journey, but loving Him is our ultimate response.
- Moses pairs the foundational truth of who God is with the command to love Him.
- The Shema affirms the unique and unified oneness of the Lord.
- Wholehearted love and devotion begin with acknowledging the Lord alone as God.

### Hear, O Israel
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/hear-o-israel
Passage: Deuteronomy 6:4-5
Points:
- The Shema declared God's unique identity to guard Israel against surrounding polytheism.
- Exclusive devotion and love flow directly from the truth that Yahweh alone is God.
- Genuine and lasting obedience must be rooted in love for the Lord rather than mere duty.
- Because no fallen person loves God perfectly, our failure points to our need for Christ's atonement.

### Hope When You Feel Spiritually Stumped
Author: Laura Bailey
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/hope-when-you-feel-spiritually-stumped-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 6:6-7
Points:
- Parents will encounter difficult spiritual questions from children that have no easy answers.
- Deuteronomy calls parents to steady, daily discipleship rather than flawless perfection.
- Facing hard questions requires praying, resting in God's character, and seeking wisdom.
- Honestly admitting our limitations humbles us and directs children to trust in Christ.
- Teaching God's ways takes place naturally across ordinary, everyday family moments.

### The Most Valuable Family Foundation
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-february-6-2023.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 6:4-7
Points:
- Families and marriages require an enduring spiritual foundation to withstand life's pressures.
- Building a household on worldly assumptions inevitably causes families to unravel.
- God's design anchors the home in wholehearted love for Him and devotion to His Word.
- Teaching children God's truth requires examining the actual foundation of our daily lives.
